changelog: PERF: Coil image downsampling — all poster grids now decode at 150×225 px (was full CDN resolution). Eliminates GC thrashing and bitmap OOM on Firestick 1GB/2GB devices during rapid scroll.
PERF: Paging 3 pageSize reduced from 60 → 20 items (initialLoadSize also capped at 20). Prevents 180-item burst loads that previously caused 2–3 second UI freezes on FireOS devices.

PERF: Favorites recomposition fix — favoriteMovieIds and favoriteSeriesIds hoisted to dedicated StateFlow<Set<Int>> in their ViewModels, decoupled from the main uiState. Adding or removing a favorite now recomposes only the affected poster card instead of the entire grid.

PERF: yield() cooperative suspension added after heavy Gson JSON parsing (VOD streams, Series) in XtreamRepository and between filterMovies/filterSeries passes in ViewModels. Prevents IO thread pool starvation and main-thread jank during large provider loads.
PERF: HomeScreen rail cards (movie posters 110×155 px, channel logos 80×80 px) now use bounded ImageRequest.size() — eliminates redundant full-res decodes in horizontal scroll rails.
